pages.text: There you are. Sit, if you like -- nothing here is going to test you.

Of course she did. Everyone comes through me eventually, and it is far easier to
learn this before you need it than during.

So. Human Form first, because Human Form is the same for every one of us. No passive,
no trick, nothing borrowed from the shape you were born to. It is the honest baseline,
and it is where you will do most of your thinking.

Here -- hold your hands like this. Mending is mostly attention. What you are watching
for is the moment somebody stops being able to ask for help.

The other shape will come when it comes. I am not going to push you into it in a
courtyard.

Then you will have it, and you will be clumsy with it, and that is survivable.

The sentry at the south gate is expecting you. Go gently.
Back so soon. Are you eating?
